'''''Star Wars''''' is a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] that began in [[January]] [[2013]].<ref name="Brian Wood to Write a New Star Wars Series!">{{DarkHorse|url=Blog/1060/brian-wood-write-new-star-wars-series|text=Brian Wood to Write a New Star Wars Series!}}</ref><ref>{{WebCite|url=http://comicsalliance.com/brian-wood-star-wars-dark-horse-comic-con-sdcc-2012|text=Brian Wood Will Be 'Star Wars' New Hope in New Ongoing Series|author=McMillan, Graeme|date=2012-07-12|archivedate=20170728104814}}</ref><ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.tgdaily.com/entertainment/64685-new-star-wars-comic-is-almost-a-reboot|text=New Star Wars comic is almost a reboot|author=Droege, C.B.|date=2012-07-14|work=TG Daily|archivedate=20171009220433}}</ref><ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.spike.com/articles/kgsgs6/all-access-weekly-comic-con-2012-new-star-wars-comic-revisits-the-original-trilogy|text=Comic-Con 2012: New Star Wars Comic Revisits The Original Trilogy|author=Kaercher, Josh|date=2012-07-13|archivedate=20170222065040}}</ref><ref>{{WebCite|url=https://io9.gizmodo.com/5924736/a-first-look-at-the-brand-new-comic-star-wars-with-darth-vader-illustrated-by-alex-ross|text=A First Look At The Brand New Comic ''Star Wars'' (With Darth Vader Illustrated By Alex Ross!)|author=Lamar, Cyriaque|date=2012-07-10|archivedate=20180618100613}}</ref>  It concluded with [[Star Wars (2013) 20|issue 20]] on [[August 13]], [[2014]].

The series takes place between [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], dating itself to two months after the Battle of Yavin. However, it heavily conflicts with the preexisting timeline of the Rebel Alliance post-Yavin; per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' and other sources, the Alliance was trapped on Yavin by the [[Yavin blockade]] for the first six months after the battle, but the comics instead depict the Alliance based on their fleet in deep space.

On [[August 14]], [[2013]], author [[Brian Wood]] announced on social media that he was contracted to continue writing for ''Star Wars'' through issue twenty, at which time he expected to conclude his writing responsibilities with the series.<ref name="Wood Tumblr">{{Tumblr|subdomain=brianwood|url=post/58243680199/status-check|name=Brian Wood|text=Status Check}}</ref>
